title: T228 PNC - When Hashem Gazes on a Soul That Can Bring Others to Repentance
hebrewTitle: כשה׳ מסתכל בנשמה שיכולה להחזיר בתשובה
author: Petten Nanach

beginner.en: When Hashem gazes upon a soul that has the rare power to bring other people to repentance and to attract converts to truth, He Himself, as it were, requests and implores that soul to go out and do its work. The soul that can change other souls is precious beyond measure. Hashem is, so to speak, in need of such a soul's service. This is why certain great individuals feel an almost irresistible calling — it is literally Hashem calling them, imploring them to go out and do the work of teshuvah for the generation.

intermediate.en: T228: When Hashem gazes on a neshama (soul) capable of bringing others to teshuvah (repentance) or attracting geirim (converts), He Himself kivy'achol (as it were) beseeches that soul to act. The soul that can transform others is uniquely precious to Hashem. LM 228.
intermediate.he: כשה׳ מסתכל בנשמה שיכולה להחזיר בתשובה ולגייר — ה׳ עצמו כביכול מבקש ומתחנן לנשמה זו שתצא לפעול.

scholarly.he: LM א׳ רכח׳ — "כשה׳ מסתכל בנשמה שיכולה להחזיר בתשובה ולעשות גרים... הוא עצמו כביכול מבקש".
